book.name: 2 Korid
book.title: 2 Korid Pol köp hain u Korid nɨbi bɨ kalɨp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Hon God aip jɨm ñöl wög gɨpun rö, kalöp manö kƚö gɨ hagun hagabun, God kalöp mög nɨŋöm ud aij göp u, arö gagmim.
God nɨpe hagöp,

content.text: “Manö ne nɨŋnam a gem mɨdainö ñɨn u,
Nöp ud kamɨŋ yunam a gainö ñɨn u,

content: Pen nɨŋim! Mɨñi ñɨn i nöp God nɨbi bɨ gau manö nɨŋnam a göm mɨdöp. Mɨñi ñɨn i nöp God nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp ud asɨk yuö, kamɨŋ arnaböl.
God nɨp wög gɨpun u ar aij gɨnɨm, a gun, nɨŋ aij gun gɨpun. Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hanɨp nɨŋöm, gasɨ rɨmnap auö, ap lug paknaböl adö u gagpun.
Pen nɨhön nɨhön gɨpun u, God nɨp wög gabun u nɨŋöl, a gun, nagɨ aij adö u nöp gɨpun. Anɨb u, God nɨp wög gun bɨsƚam mɨdun arö gagpun. Mɨŋör nɨhön nɨhön gö, uɫham mɨdpun a gun gasɨ anɨbu nɨŋagpun.

Hanɨp ñɨn rɨmnap mɨñu magö pakpal; ñɨn rɨmnap nagɨ lɨbal; ñɨn rɨmnap ram mɨnöŋ ap bɨ uraköm polisman aip aka ami bɨ aip pen pen göm söl hanɨp aŋ au abe al pak lɨbal; ñɨn rɨmnap wög gɨ dam dam ake lagpun; ñɨn rɨmnap han aij gagpun; ñɨn rɨmnap kɨyö hanbun.
Pen gasɨ aij nöp nɨŋun, nɨŋ aij gun, nɨbi bɨ kalɨp nɨŋno, hon mulu lugö wasö, kalɨp ud aij gɨpun. Hon aige göl gun anɨg gɨpun? Ana Uɫ hanɨp aŋ daŋ mɨdöp u me, nɨbi bɨ mɨdmagö yabɨƚ lɨbun;
God hanɨp kƚö nɨpe ñö, Krais manö aij u kabö göl nöp hagpun; gɨ aij gep u haƚaun gasaƚ hon rö ñɨmagö yɨjɨg abe ñɨmagö sɨdagö abe mɨdöp.

Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hib hon haglö adö aröp; nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hib hon udlö yagol lugöp. Rɨmnap hanɨp manö aij hagpal; rɨmnap hanɨp manö naij hagpal. Hon bɨ piral hagep a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋbal u pen hon manö nɨŋö nöp hagpun;
hon nɨbi bɨ hib mɨdagöp yabɨƚ a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋbal u pen hib hon nɨŋbal; hadö umbun rö löp u pen kamɨŋ mɨdpun. Hanɨp mɨñu magö pakpal u pen umagpun;
mɨŋör kub göp u pen mɨñ mɨñ göl gɨ mɨdpun; bɨ mög gep rö mɨdpun u pen wög hon gɨpun adö u nɨbi bɨ iru nöp nɨbi bɨ gep rö mɨdpal; nan mɨdagöp rö mɨdpun u pen magöŋhalö udpun.
Korid nɨbi bɨ gau, kalöp manö pi gun hagagabun, waiö yabɨƚ hagabun; kalöp mɨdmagö lɨbun.
Hon kalöp mɨdmagö lɨmɨdun u, uri u rö nöp anɨg göl nöp gɨpun pen kale hanɨp mɨdmagö lɨmɨdim nagɨ adö u pen dam gai yubim.
Kalöp ñɨ pai yad rö lö me hagabin: hon kalöp mɨdmagö lɨbun rö, kale u rö nöp hon mɨdmagö lɨmim.
Nɨbi bɨ Krais nɨp nɨŋ udagpal gau aip jɨm ñagmim

Kale nɨbi bɨ Krais nɨp nɨŋ udagpal gau aip jɨm ñagmim. Nɨbi bɨ gɨ aij gɨpal gau, aige göl göm nɨbi bɨ gɨ aij gagpal gau aip jɨm ñöl gɨlö arö aij gɨnab? Nɨbi bɨ mailö mɨdpal gau, aige göl göm nɨbi bɨ sɨbön yaŋ mɨdpal gau aip jɨm ñöl gɨlö arö aij gɨnab?
Krais aip kɨjaki aip manö hag adö añɨ lagnabil. Nɨbi bɨ Krais nɨp nɨŋ udpal gau, nɨbi bɨ Krais nɨp nɨŋ udagpal gau aip u rö nöp gasɨ adö añɨ nɨŋagnaböl.
God kamɨŋ u, hon sabe gep ram nɨpe mɨdpun. God nɨpe haga,
Pen God sabe gep ram aip, nan yɨharɨŋ sabe gɨpal nan piral gau aip, manö ap hag adö añɨ löm gɨlö arnɨm rö lagöp.
Anɨb u, Bɨ Kub nɨpe haga,

content.text: Nan yɨp asɨŋ la gau uɫ maɫɨ gageinabim u,
Yad Bɨ Kub unbö ke, bɨ gep yabɨƚ u,
